lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.title: Notes of a Wanderer
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.author: A nameless wanderer
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.1:
Day 1.

The stone I found by the creek hums. Not loudly, more like a glass that sings when you run a finger along its rim. At night it glows violet.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.2:
Day 4.

I can't sleep with it beside me. I wrapped it in wool and buried it under the oak. In the morning it was lying next to my bedroll again.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.3:
Day 9.

There are more of them. Where shards sit in the rock, the air is colder and my compass spins. Every shard points the same way: inward.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.4:
Day 14.

A cave wall covered in carvings. A frame of square stones, a key held up to it, and light pouring out. Beneath it, one word I cannot read.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.5:
Day 21.

The villagers won't look at the stone. An old woman told me her grandmother heard the same humming, the summer the creek ran violet.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.6:
Day 27.

I dream of a city made of glass, and a song that holds it together. In the dream someone sings a wrong note, and I wake up bleeding from the nose.
lore.shardline.wanderer_notes.page.7:
Day 30.

I built the frame, just as the carvings showed. The key fits. Beyond the light lies a world made of shards.

I am going through. If you find this, follow me.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.title: The Crystal Realm of Aurelis
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.author: Chronicler Veyl
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.1: Before the Shard Expanse there was Aurelis: a single, endless crystal where cities grew like blossoms. Light flowed through its veins, and every creature heard its song.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.2: Nobody built a house in Aurelis. One sang to the crystal until it grew into the shape one needed. A good singer could raise a tower in a single summer.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.3: At the center lay the Heart, a crystal as tall as a mountain, from which the song flowed outward. Around it stood the Throne Hall, where the Keepers met.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.4: The song held everything together. Those who sang it could shape stone and close wounds. The elders called it the Resonance and guarded it like a treasure.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.5: We had moths that carried light from street to street, and gentle rays that drifted over the plains. Even the foxes could step between shadows.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.6: There was no word for void in our language. Beneath the realm there was only more crystal. Today the void is the first thing every child learns to fear.
lore.shardline.crystal_kingdom.page.7: I write this so that someone remembers. I fear that soon no one will know the islands were once a single whole.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.title: The Keepers' Oath
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.author: The Order of Keepers
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.1: We, the Keepers of Aurelis, swear: we preserve the song. We heal what breaks. We guard the gate to the Heart, so that no one unworthy may touch it.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.2: We take no crown and no land. What we sing belongs to all. Whoever comes to us wounded, we heal, be they friend or stranger.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.3: We wear white, so that every stain shows. We carry no blade into the Throne Hall. We speak no word in anger before the Heart.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.4: Each Keeper is given a cape woven from the Heart's light. It is returned when they die, and woven anew for the next who swears.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.5: We swear by crystal and light: should the song ever fall silent or turn against us, we will give all that we are to bind it.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.6:
Whoever breaks this oath, may their armor shatter and their name fade from the crystal.

Signed by seven hundred hands.
lore.shardline.keepers_oath.page.7:
(A later hand, in hurried script:)

Six hundred and ninety-nine kept it. One of us ran. I know, because I am the one.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.title: On the Resonance
lore.shardline.the_resonance.author: Magister Orrin
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.1: The Resonance is not magic but rhythm. Every crystal vibrates with its neighbors. Disturb one and you disturb them all, and they all disturb you back.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.2: A healer does not close a wound. She sings the right beat, and the body remembers how it was. A builder does the same with stone. It is all memory.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.3: Deep beneath the Heart I found a place where the song sounds wrong. A tone that does not fade but multiplies. It devours beats. It copies itself.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.4: I measured it for thirty nights. Every night it was louder. Every crystal it touches begins to sing it too. It does not destroy the song. It replaces it.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.5: Where did it come from? Perhaps from outside, through some crack between worlds. Perhaps we made it ourselves, from one careless note, sung too often.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.6: I call it the Shard Tone. The younger ones already call it a virus. I warned the council. They laughed and blamed my lack of sleep.
lore.shardline.the_resonance.page.7:
Postscript.

A miner from the lower shafts came to my door today. His arms were glowing. Nobody is laughing anymore.
lore.shardline.first_infection.title: The First Infection
lore.shardline.first_infection.author: Healer Maelis
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.1: The miner came to me with violet veins along his arms. Fever, trembling, he saw colors that were not there. On the third day his skin chimed when he moved.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.2: I sang the healing beat over him for two days. It did nothing. Worse: when I stopped, I could still hear his tone in my head. It had learned my song.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.3: We call it Shard Fever now. Where the sick lie, the ground begins to glow. Animals that graze there turn to crystal and follow the tone.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.4: The crystallized cows still give birth. The calves are born glowing. They do not low; they ring, like bells in the wind.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.5: The miner died on the ninth day. Or rather: he stood up on the ninth day and walked toward the lower shafts. We did not stop him. We did not dare.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.6: Only pure light eases it. An essence of glowblooms, strengthened by a heart of pure crystal, cleanses flesh and stone.
lore.shardline.first_infection.page.7:
But we have no such heart. The only pure heart left in Aurelis is the Heart itself, and the virus already sleeps beneath it.

Gods help us.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.title: Blueprint of the Warden
lore.shardline.the_colossus.author: Master Smith Duran
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.1: By order of the council: a warden for the bridge to the Heart. Forged from crystal and faith, without fear and without sleep. It shall test all who seek the throne.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.2: Height: eleven paces. Weight: unknown, the scales broke. Material: crystal from the lowest layer, where the song is oldest and slowest.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.3: Its fists strike the ground and call pillars from below. When it is wounded, it calls on lesser shards to fight for it, and grows faster. A warden must not give up.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.4: In its chest I set a core. Only those who defeat the warden can take it, and only the core opens the throne. So no one shall reach the Queen unprepared.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.5: The core is not cold stone. It carries a fragment of the Heart's pure song. A smith who works it could make armor stronger than any we know.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.6: It sleeps on its altar until someone wakes it with a crystal. I gave it this rest so it would not go mad from waiting.
lore.shardline.the_colossus.page.7:
It will not know why it keeps watch. It will only keep watch.

Forgive me, Colossus, for giving you no end.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.title: The Last Knights
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.author: Captain Kael
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.1: We have held the walls for forty days. The infected come in waves. Whoever is wounded begins to glow, and by morning they stand on the other side.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.2:
Day 41.

Today I faced my own squire across the wall. He still wore the badge I gave him. I could not strike. Brann did it for me.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.3: Our armor is cracking. The tone seeps into the steel. Some of my men keep fighting even though nothing remains in their helmets but shards.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.4:
Day 50.

The Keepers sent word: Hold until the ritual is done. What ritual? The messenger would not say. He only cried.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.5:
Day 52.

The ground shook. A tone so high that our shields sang. Then the wall tore away beneath us and drifted out into the dark.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.6: We are still here. A tower, an island, nothing around it. We guard the stairs. We do not know for whom. The order was never lifted.
lore.shardline.the_last_knights.page.7:
If you find this: we are not your enemies. We only guard what we no longer understand. Forgive us if we attack you.

– Kael
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.title: Selvaine, the Glass-Crowned
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.author: Chronicler Veyl
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.1: Selvaine was not the mightiest of the Keepers, but the most patient. While the council argued, she listened to the Shard Tone. For days. For nights.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.2: She was a weaver's daughter from the outer rings. Her crown of glass was not a sign of rank. She sang it herself as a girl, and it never broke.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.3: The council wanted to destroy the Heart. Orrin said: then the realm dies with it. Others wanted to flee. To where? There was nothing but Aurelis.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.4: She said: it cannot be destroyed, it has become part of the song. But it can be given a home it cannot escape.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.5: "And who shall be that home?" asked the council. Selvaine did not answer. She only looked at them, one after another, until nobody asked again.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.6: On the day of the ritual she set down her crown and walked into the Heart alone. When she returned, her skin was glass and her eyes were full of violet.
lore.shardline.queen_selvaine.page.7: She took the crown back and sat on the throne. She has not risen since. Some say she still hums the old song, very quietly, under the wrong one.
lore.shardline.the_seal.title: The Seal
lore.shardline.the_seal.author: Selvaine
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.1: I am the seal. The tone lives within me, locked in every one of my shards. As long as I breathe, Aurelis is safe, or what remains of it.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.2: I did not know the realm would break. I felt it tear apart as the tone entered me. A thousand islands, a thousand screams. I could not hold everything.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.3: It whispers without end. It wants out. With every century I forget more of myself and become more of it.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.4: I still remember my mother's loom. The smell of warm crystal in summer. I write these things down so the tone cannot take them.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.5: When someone approaches, I can no longer tell friend from foe. My hands rain shards before I can think. I will drive away anyone who comes near.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.6:
Whoever reads this: do not kill me. If I fall, the seal breaks, and the tone will find every world connected to this one.

Yours too.
lore.shardline.the_seal.page.7:
And if you must, because you are stronger than my plea: then finish what I began. Do not let the tone go free.

– S.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.title: The Day of Shattering
lore.shardline.the_shattering.author: Unknown
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.1: When the seal was closed, Aurelis held its breath. Then it burst. Not a bang, but a tone so high that birds fell from the sky.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.2: I was at the market of the eastern ring. The ground opened between two stalls. On one side stood my sister. On the other, I did.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.3: The realm broke into a thousand islands drifting into nothing. Cities hung on crystal pillars above the abyss. After that we only called it the Expanse.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.4: In some places the song simply stopped. The forests there turned to ash, gray and silent. Only blind wanderers walk there now.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.5: Below the islands the crystal glowed in deep caves, far from the tone. Many of us fled there. The caves still glow today.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.6: The Queen stayed on her throne at the center, ringed by pillars. No one dares go there anymore. The Colossus guards bridges that no longer exist.
lore.shardline.the_shattering.page.7:
I never saw my sister again. Sometimes, when the wind is right, I think I hear her calling from another island.

I call back. Always.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.title: The Trader's Ledger
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.author: The Shard Trader
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.1:
Income: 14 shards, 2 knight crests.
Expenses: a map to the Colossus Arena, once again.

They all go. They rarely come back.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.2:
Stock:
3 Shard Keys
1 cracked moth lantern
12 glowberries (old)
1 white cape, never worn since. Not for sale.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.3: Note to self: tell the new ones nothing about the throne until they are ready.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.4: I was a Keeper once. I was there when she performed the ritual. When the tone rose, I ran. I was still running when the ground broke.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.5: Since then I trade. Shards for food, maps for courage. Out here no one asks who you were. That suits me.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.6:
Debts:
to Selvaine, one oath.
to the six hundred and ninety-nine, everything.
lore.shardline.traders_ledger.page.7: If one of them means to slay the Queen, I must warn them. Will they believe me? Nobody believes a trader. Perhaps that is my punishment.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.title: On the Core of the Breach
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.author: Magister Orrin
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.1:
Written in the last days before the ritual, for those who come after.

If you are reading this, the worst has perhaps already happened.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.2: Should the seal ever break, the tone will form knots: hearts of crystal that pump it into the world. They grow where it is thickest and defend themselves.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.3: Purify the land around you first. A pure light anchored in the ground holds the tone at bay. Without it you will not survive long enough.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.4: Destroy the hearts, and the tone condenses. After the third, it no longer finds room in the world and becomes a core you can hold in your hand.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.5: This Core of the Breach can be carried back to the throne. There are two paths: seal it again, as Selvaine did, or dominate it.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.6: To seal it is to silence the tone forever, though what it has touched remains. To dominate it is to let it sing, to your rhythm.
lore.shardline.the_breach_core.page.7:
I cannot tell you which path is right. Selvaine chose the first and lost herself. Perhaps you are stronger than she was.

Choose wisely.
vision.shardline.0.title: Aurelis
vision.shardline.0.subtitle: A world in one piece
vision.shardline.0.line.1: You see a crystal as vast as a continent. Light flows through it like blood.
vision.shardline.0.line.2: Cities grow from its flanks. Everywhere a calm, warm song hums.
vision.shardline.0.line.3: A voice whispers: “Remember how it was.”
vision.shardline.1.title: The Wrong Tone
vision.shardline.1.subtitle: Deep beneath the Heart
vision.shardline.1.line.1: A magister kneels in a cave, hands pressed over his ears.
vision.shardline.1.line.2: A single tone swells, copies itself and devours the song beat by beat.
vision.shardline.1.line.3: The crystal walls turn violet, from the inside out.
vision.shardline.2.title: The Keepers' Council
vision.shardline.2.subtitle: Seven hundred voices
vision.shardline.2.line.1: Keepers in white cloaks argue in a hall of glass.
vision.shardline.2.line.2: “Destroy the Heart!” – “Then we all die!” – “Bind it!”
vision.shardline.2.line.3: A woman with a crown of glass stays silent and listens.
vision.shardline.3.title: The Ritual
vision.shardline.3.subtitle: Selvaine takes up the burden
vision.shardline.3.line.1: The Queen sets down her crown and steps into the pulsing Heart.
vision.shardline.3.line.2: The violet tone pours into her until her skin turns to glass.
vision.shardline.3.line.3: Her last human tear becomes a shard.
vision.shardline.4.title: The Shattering
vision.shardline.4.subtitle: Aurelis breaks
vision.shardline.4.line.1: A tone so bright it hurts. Cracks race across the sky.
vision.shardline.4.line.2: The land breaks into islands drifting into the dark.
vision.shardline.4.line.3: You feel your own shard trembling in your pocket.
vision.shardline.5.title: The Warden
vision.shardline.5.subtitle: Forged without end
vision.shardline.5.line.1: A smith sets a glowing core into the chest of a crystal giant.
vision.shardline.5.line.2: “Test all who seek the throne. Let no one unworthy pass.”
vision.shardline.5.line.3: The Colossus opens its eyes and will never close them again.
vision.shardline.6.title: The Last Knights
vision.shardline.6.subtitle: Loyal until they break
vision.shardline.6.line.1: Knights hold a wall against a flood of glowing figures.
vision.shardline.6.line.2: Their armor bursts. Shards fill the empty helmets.
vision.shardline.6.line.3: A captain shouts “Hold the line!”, and no one remembers why.
vision.shardline.7.title: The Warning
vision.shardline.7.subtitle: Whoever breaks the seal …
vision.shardline.7.line.1: The glass Queen looks straight at you. She recognizes you.
vision.shardline.7.line.2: “I am the seal. If I fall, the tone is free. In your world too.”
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_0.intr: Oh! A face without shard dust. Rare around here.
You don't carry a shard yet, do you? It would have called you long ago.
Search the depths for violet ore. Listen for the humming.
Then come back. I trade in anything that glitters.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_0.idle: That humming? That's not you. That's the stone.
Come back when you've got something shiny.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_1.intr: You found a shard. I can see it in your eyes, they're already glowing a little.
Every shard wants to return to the Expanse it came from.
Build a frame of Shard Portal Frames and open it with a Shard Key.
But pack food. Not much grows over there that you'd want to eat.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_1.idle: A key, a frame, a little courage. That's all it takes.
The shards grow warmer the closer you get to the gate.
I'll gladly sell you a key. For the right price.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_2.intr: Welcome to the Shard Expanse. Or what's left of it.
These islands were once a single realm: Aurelis. Then it shattered.
Mind the ruins. The Keepers left books behind, and crystals that remember.
And if you see Shattered Knights: they mean no harm. They just don't know any better.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_2.idle: Don't fall off the edge. There's nothing below. Truly nothing.
Glow moths love glowblooms. Good friends in the dark.
Have you touched a Memory Crystal yet? They show things.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_3.intr: You've heard the echoes. So now you know about the Keepers.
They locked something away back then. Something that sounded wrong in the song.
The road to the truth leads past the Crystal Colossus. Its core opens the throne.
I have maps to its arena. I only sell them because you'll go anyway.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_3.idle: The books don't lie. But they don't tell everything either.
The Colossus sleeps until someone places an Awakening Crystal on its altar.
Gather the memories. Each one shows a little more.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_4.intr: You carry the Colossus Core. I can hear it singing.
Listen to me. I was a Keeper once. I was there when Selvaine performed the ritual.
The Queen on the throne is the seal. The virus lives inside her. If she dies, it is free.
I can't stop you. But if you go, be ready to bear the consequences.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_4.idle: She doesn't attack you because she's evil. She protects us. From you.
Her heart would give you great power. And all of us great suffering.
I warned you. An old trader can do no more.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_5.intr: You did it. I heard the tone, right down to my bones.
The Shardvirus is free. It crawls through the portals and nests in the ore.
The Queen's heart can be brewed into a Purification Essence. And anchors that keep it away.
Nothing is lost yet. But it will get worse before it gets better.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_5.idle: Don't linger on violet ground. The fever creeps up on you.
Glass bottle, three glowblooms, an ingot and the heart. You keep the heart.
The villagers of your world are already running. They can feel it.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_6.intr: You're fighting back. Good. Selvaine would have liked that.
In the worst zones, Virus Hearts grow. They pump the tone into the world.
Destroy three of them, and the tone condenses into the Core of the Breach.
Bring it to the throne. That is where this story's ending is decided.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_6.idle: Seal or dominate. I know what I'd choose. But it's your choice.
Purity Anchors keep the virus at bay. Put them around your homes.
A Virus Heart calls for help. Never fight one alone.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.intro.1: It has gone quiet. Do you hear that? The tone is silent.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.intro.2: You did what Selvaine did, without giving up yourself.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.intro.3: The scars remain. The infected land will never be entirely pure again.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.intro.4: But it no longer grows. Thank you, Keeper.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.idle.1: The cape suits you. The old Keepers wore it just the same.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.idle.2: Sometimes I think the crystals are singing the old song again.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.idle.3: Shall we trade? For once without the end of the world.
dialogue.shardline.trader.dominated.intr: You didn't seal it. You tamed it.
The tone obeys you. I can see it in the creatures that follow you.
It keeps spreading, you know that. But now to your rhythm.
I hope you know what you're doing, Shard Sovereign.
dialogue.shardline.trader.dominated.idle: Keep your crystal cows away from my stall.
Some call you a savior. Others a new tyrant.
Of course I'll trade with you. I'm not tired of living.

dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_0.more: Where I come from? Farther than your compass can point.
The shards buried in your world's ore are fragments of a realm called Aurelis.
Sometimes I find loose pages of old books. Bring me some, I pay well.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_1.more: One shard alone is just a stone. Many together remember a song.
The frame needs obsidian, because only obsidian endures the hum.
Once you are across, follow the pale pillars. That is where the keepers stood.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_2.more: See the pale ruins? Those were the keepers' halls. They held council there before everything shattered.
Pages of their chronicles still lie in those halls. Loose leaves, scattered by the wind.
Four pages of the same book and I will bind it anew. I did that for the council, long ago.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_3.more: The keepers heard the false tone first. They argued for a long time about what to do.
Selvaine was the most patient of them. That is why the choice fell on her.
I sat on that council. I voted for the seal. I still wonder whether it was right.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_4.more: The Colossus was never her enemy. He was her guardian. As I once was.
If you kill the Queen, an altar will grow before the throne. The council prepared it for that day.
I hope it stays in the stone. I truly do.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_5.more: The animals of your world graze on the sick grass. Then they carry the tone onward.
A crystallized soul is not lost. The essence brings it back - even villagers, with their old craft.
An altar stands before the throne now. It waits for a core that does not exist yet.
dialogue.shardline.trader.chapter_6.more: A Virus Heart hardens when it is wounded. Then it strikes back harder. Do not give up.
When it screams, it calls the infected. Keep away from the spore swirls on the ground.
With the core in hand the altar awakens. Gold for the seal, magenta for dominion.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.more.1: The keeper ruins have gone quiet. Sometimes I go there and read the old books aloud.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.more.2: Selvaine is free. What is left of her sings in the crystals.
dialogue.shardline.trader.sealed.more.3: Keep bringing me loose pages. I want the chronicle complete before I go.
dialogue.shardline.trader.dominated.more: Your servants follow you like hounds. You gave them collars? How kind.
The tone grows. In your rhythm, yes. But it grows.
I will still sell you what you want. But I write everything down. Someone has to remember.
dialogue.shardline.trader.lore.none: Loose pages? You have none with you. They lie in old chests, above all in the keeper ruins.
dialogue.shardline.trader.lore.offer: Ah, pages from the chronicles. I give you shards for each one. Not fair, but honest.
dialogue.shardline.trader.lore.offer_bin: Four pages of the same book! I can bind it for you - or I buy the pages.
dialogue.shardline.trader.lore.sold: A good deal. For both of us. Mostly for me.
dialogue.shardline.trader.lore.bound: There. Bound tight, like in the old council days. Read it well.
